answer.question: Compare consumer revenue Q2 2025
answer.text:
JPMorgan Chase's Consumer & Community Banking reported revenue of $18,847 million in Q2 2025 (managed/FTE basis). [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd]

Bank of America's Consumer Banking reported revenue of $10,813 million in Q2 2025 (FTE basis). [24560d35a94aa52fcb21]

JPMorgan Chase's reported figure was $8,034 million higher than Bank of America. That is 74.3% higher using Bank of America as the base; JPMorgan Chase/Bank of America revenue ratio: 1.74×. [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd] [24560d35a94aa52fcb21]

These are reported segment figures without peer adjustments; segment scope, reporting conventions and internal allocations may differ.

answer.question: Compare consumer revenue Q2 2025
answer.text:
JPMorgan Chase's Consumer & Community Banking reported revenue of $18,847 million in Q2 2025 (managed/FTE basis). [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd]

Bank of America's Consumer Banking reported revenue of $10,813 million in Q2 2025 (FTE basis). [24560d35a94aa52fcb21]

Bank of America's reported figure was $8,034 million lower than JPMorgan Chase. That is 42.6% lower using JPMorgan Chase as the base; Bank of America/JPMorgan Chase revenue ratio: 0.57×. [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd] [24560d35a94aa52fcb21]

These are reported segment figures without peer adjustments; segment scope, reporting conventions and internal allocations may differ.
